# FDGD057

> NOT PERMITTED: Changing a `virtual` Member to `abstract`

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section D.11.21 Changing a virtual Member to abstract. Applies to: runtime and compilation breaks.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Breaks like removing the override of an `abstract` member (FDGD033). PublicApiAnalyzers (optional in /fdg-setup) can flag changes to the public API.

## From the book

Changing a member from `virtual` to `abstract` is breaking in the same ways that removing an immediate override to an `abstract` member is. See section D.9.5 for information on the full impact of this type of change.

The .NET BCL team considers this an unacceptable breaking change.
